description: For an agent that holds USDC on Base: returns the HTTP address where one Pay2GPT plan is bought with the x402 payment protocol, with the current price in US cents and in USDC atomic units. This tool pays nothing. A GET to the returned url answers 402 with the payment requirements; the same GET with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header settles the payment and returns the order number and the order page, where the buyer connects their own ChatGPT account.

email.description: The buyer's email address; order updates go there

plan.description: Plan slug from list_plans, such as plus

name: get_x402_checkout
title: Get the x402 payment address of a plan
